mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% annualized indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating inflation that triggers central bank rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) and rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS above 2.0%) indicates an overheating economy with aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE < 4.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline below its 12-month moving average signals supply chain disruption that reduces corporate output and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payroll increase above 150,000 units indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate revenue, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150,000 units.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts decline below 1,300,000 units signals weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST falls below 1,300,000 units.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) indicates demand-supply mismatch with inflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized and INDPRO < 100.0 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.
